description: Stereo widener: the input is delayed by a few milliseconds into both channels with the right one inverted, and that pair is blended against the dry mid signal

params.text: Picks whether the Time knob is read in milliseconds or in samples
Sets the delay, 1ms to 30ms, or 1 to 50 samples when the switch is set to samples
Spreads the delayed pair across the stereo field, from centred at 0% to fully separated at 100%
Crossfades the output between the dry mid signal at 0% and the widened side signal at 100%

inputs.text: Shifts the delay time, a tenth of the knob's travel per volt
Shifts the width, a tenth of the knob's travel per volt
Shifts the mid-to-side blend, a tenth of the knob's travel per volt
Left audio in; with the right jack empty this signal is used for both channels and the module works in its mono layout
Right audio in; patching it puts the module into its stereo layout, where the output is rebuilt from the mid and the side of the return signals
Takes the place of the internal delayed left signal in the output, for running the left send through an effect and back
Takes the place of the dry mid signal in the output
Takes the place of the internal delayed right signal in the output

outputs.text: The delayed left signal after the width spread, for feeding an effect
The two inputs summed and halved, before any delay
The delayed right signal after the width spread, inverted against the left one
Left output, the mid and the side blended as the Mid/Side knob sets
Right output, the mid and the side blended as the Mid/Side knob sets

notes: three lamps show the level of the mid and of each side; the mid lamp dims and the two side lamps brighten as Mid/Side is turned up.
the delay length is recalculated from a slewed copy of the Time setting only at the moment the knob, the CV or the switch changes, so it settles part-way towards the value the knob shows.
